title: A tracking change is refused for a user who has just lost the right to delete
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-REVOKE-TRACK) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-TRACK-ROLE), which starts with 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit', 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • {User-D} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • The Admin can cut {Role-D} down during the steps to 'Part Library & Inventory → View' only, with See Financial Data and every Settings permission unticked, so {User-D} becomes a user who cannot delete inventory parts while a screen is still open.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-TRK-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-D}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-D}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Do not save yet.
  4. In the Admin window go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, edit {Role-D}: in the Part Library and Inventory group untick Create & Edit and Delete (keep View), untick See Financial Data and every Settings permission, and click Save.
  5. In {User-D}'s window click Save.
  6. Read the message shown.
  7. In the Admin window search {Part-A} and read its Total Qty.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: If the screen closed the dialog or disabled Save before you could click, write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 6: The save is refused with an access denied error.
  • Step 7: {Part-A} still shows "2 Available": its tracking did not change.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-N2, S8-R15, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.2 (Switch off), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Tech plan 7 Oct 2026, §9 Security. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N2: “If that user tries to change a part's tracking by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-R15: “The system accepts a status change, a tracking change and an untracked part from exactly the users it accepts an inventory part delete from today.”
